{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Drop rows with customer_age == -1 for age-related analysis
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]

# Check final shape
print(f'Final dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}')

# Check status
df_clean['status'].value_counts()"}
